say:2:1730305301:1.text: That's right! The council deserves credit for executing these policies!
say:2:1730305301:1.source_cn: 说得对啊！而且政策的推行背后内阁功劳也不容忽视！
say:2:1730305301:1.male: That's right! The council deserves credit for executing these policies!
say:2:1730305301:1.female: That's right! The council deserves credit for executing these policies!

say:3:1730305302:1.text: Had the council members been lazy and unwilling to cooperate...
say:3:1730305302:1.source_cn: 如果内阁的大人们懒惰消极，不配合王后推行政策。
say:3:1730305302:1.male: Had the council members been lazy and unwilling to cooperate...
say:3:1730305302:1.female: Had the council members been lazy and unwilling to cooperate...

say:4:1730305303:1.text: None of the Queen's sound policies would have made it beyond the palace!
say:4:1730305303:1.source_cn: 那王后就算推行再正确的政策也难出王宫！
say:4:1730305303:1.male: None of the Queen's sound policies would have made it beyond the palace!
say:4:1730305303:1.female: None of the Queen's sound policies would have made it beyond the palace!
